items.title: Juneau目录遍历任意文件读取
items.title_zh: Juneau目录遍历任意文件读取
items.summary_zh: 远程访问DirectoryResource即可用路径穿越读取根目录外文件，导致敏感文件泄露
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，限制DirectoryResource目录
items.repro_note: 访问DirectoryResource，用../越出根目录读文件；需服务暴露
items.impact_scope: 微服务文件接口，内网暴露面
items.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The microservice DirectoryResource does not keep request paths inside its configured root directory.

items.title: Juneau动态类加载可执行初始化
items.title_zh: Juneau动态类加载可执行初始化
items.summary_zh: 解析java.lang.Class属性时加载类路径内类并触发静态初始化，可能执行代码
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，避免解析外部可控Class属性
items.repro_note: 向解析Class属性的接口提交类名，观察静态初始化；需可控属性
items.description: Improper control of dynamically-loaded code vulnerability in Apache Juneau. When Apache Juneau parses a value into a property of type java.lang.Class (including parameterized forms), the default class swap loaded the named class with initialization enabled, so input naming a class on the application classpath ran that class's static initializer.

items.title: Juneau CSRF可投递任意请求体
items.title_zh: Juneau CSRF可投递任意请求体
items.summary_zh: 跨站链接可向无CORS预检端点投递任意请求体，绕过基于方法或内容类型的防护
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，敏感端点增加CSRF令牌校验
items.repro_note: 构造跨站请求向无CORS预检端点发送自定义体；需目标端点无令牌
items.impact_scope: Java Web服务端点，依赖用户会话
items.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Apache Juneau. A cross-site link can therefore deliver an attacker-chosen request body to an endpoint without a CORS preflight, defeating protections that rely on the HTTP method or content type instead of an anti-CSRF token.

items.title: Juneau日志记录未脱敏敏感头
items.title_zh: Juneau日志记录未脱敏敏感头
items.summary_zh: 服务器错误时默认调用日志记录请求头且不脱敏，凭据等敏感信息可泄露给日志访问者
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，对错误请求头日志脱敏
items.repro_note: 触发服务端错误，使默认日志记录含Authorization等头；需日志访问
items.impact_scope: 日志系统，凭据二次泄露风险
items.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The default REST server call logger records request headers for requests that end in a server error, without redacting them.

items.title: Juneau错误响应泄露内部异常
items.title_zh: Juneau错误响应泄露内部异常
items.summary_zh: 错误响应头与响应体返回内部异常类及消息，攻击者可获取应用内部信息
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，关闭Thrown头及异常详情回显
items.repro_note: 请求任意错误接口，检查Thrown响应头及错误体内部异常信息
items.description: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The REST server sends the internal exception class and message to clients in a "Thrown" response header on every error response, and can include internal exception messages in the error body, even when stack-trace rendering is disabled.

items.title: Juneau客户端重定向泄露凭据
items.title_zh: Juneau客户端重定向泄露凭据
items.summary_zh: RestClient跟随跨主机或降级重定向仍带Authorization等头，凭据可被恶意服务器获取
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，禁止跨域重定向携带认证头
items.repro_note: 控制重定向到异主机或HTTPS→HTTP，观察RestClient是否带认证头
items.impact_scope: REST客户端，出站凭据可泄露
items.description: Insufficiently Protected Credentials vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The Apache Juneau RestClient followed HTTP redirects while keeping credential headers from the original request, so a server that redirected the client to a different host or port, or from HTTPS to HTTP, could receive headers such as Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization and X-API-Key.

items.title: Juneau响应头CRLF注入
items.summary_zh: 应用用请求数据设置响应头或跳转目标时，远程客户端可注入头行或跳转外站
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，过滤响应头与跳转目标CR/LF
items.repro_note: 在设置响应头或跳转的请求参数中注入CRLF，检查头分裂或外跳
items.impact_scope: Java Web应用，响应头注入面
items.description: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Response Splitting') vulnerability in Apache Juneau. An application that sets a response header or redirect target from request data could let a remote client inject header lines (where the servlet container does not itself reject CR/LF) or redirect users to an arbitrary external site.

items.title: Juneau请求数据反射XSS
items.summary_zh: 应用将请求头、表单或路径值未编码回显到页面，攻击者可注入脚本窃取会话
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juneau修复版本，对页面回显请求数据做编码
items.repro_note: 在含请求变量的页面参数中注入脚本，检查未编码反射
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Apache Juneau. Applications whose chrome includes request-derived variables, such as request headers, form data or path values, reflect those values unencoded, allowing cross-site scripting.
